published_whole_rover_inertia.scope: Whole-rover touchdown simulation inputs, not a per-link flight mass model. Source axes differ from ROVER_NAV; X is vertical inferred from four equal X wheel contacts; longitudinal axis Z. Requires audited axis mapping before direct use. Products of inertia not provided.

limitations: No public source reviewed provides all flight link masses/inertias; analytic partition remains an explicitly labeled modeling assumption.
No lidar fitted. No GPS receiver fitted.
Science instrument interfaces do not claim chemical/radiation/weather sensor physics.
Payload cameras follow historical calibration reference configurations, not mission-state health in 2026.

mastcam_left.limitation: Rendering-only near clipping bypasses opaque lens/camera-housing surfaces in the NASA visualization mesh while preserving calibrated optical centers and orientations. Objects inside the near plane cannot be rendered. This is not a measured flight optical near limit. Full calibrated lens distortion and detector response are not simulated.

mahli.reason: Official CAHVOR camera pose refers to a different arm pose. Current mount is derived from NASA visualization MAHLI LED aperture geometry, not a flight-calibrated extrinsic.
mahli.method: Optical center estimated by mean of four LED disk centroids; boresight is the common disk PCA normal oriented away from camera body; camera up follows paired LED row direction.
